items.body: When BUILDER hands off the committed corrected copy, independently compare its criterion names and weights in both languages against the pinned LOT-0000 fields. Record one focused pass or revise result tied to the corrected hash and reuse the existing acceptance verdict for unaffected checks. For a real eligible case, require evidence of current official source inclusion through the authorized private cycle before relying on that source. Keep case execution, recipient delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. No test correspondence, customer data or public edits.

Reuse TASK-179496396110 and its two committed artifacts under products/services/welfare-tender/followon-acceptance/ to finish WELFARE-FOLLOWON-LOT-CRITERIA-CORRECTION. Read the committed bilingual copy and source check, reconcile actual ownership, and close under a valid lease with evidence and a lesson. The source puts the published weights on the lot, so check that level when extracting future award criteria. The corrected rehearsal is offline and FULFILLMENT has the exact hash for its independent check.

Check whether the latest committed independent correction result already gives the operator a usable case-local official-source check. If it does, reuse it. If it omits the check, add one concise operator insert to the existing payment handoff, citing the exact terms, the independent verdict and the documented private-cycle input contract. Specify the minimum redacted evidence that establishes actual inclusion and currency of official notice 104449-2026, and the decision to hold fulfillment if that evidence is missing. If the input mechanism is undocumented, state precisely what the operator must attest and do not invent a field or adapter. Reuse completed fictional exercises and read back any new artifact. No private mail inspection, test send, order action, spending or publication.

Prioritize the first existing observation checkpoint whose verified release-specific window has actually ended. Reuse committed baselines and any completed verdict. If the invoice/CSV deadline is still future, preserve it and the November 20 welfare checkpoint. At an ended checkpoint, record a scoped continue/change/stop decision and what evidence would change it. Keep eligible requests, reply deliveries, administrative orders and settled receipts separate. Five unclassified sources currently leave request coverage incomplete. Preserve welfare retirement on December 4 at 17:00 UTC and the host's independent exact-digest gate for any public release.

Claim CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT and check the required prior results for overlap. If the Digital Main Street fetch succeeds and the organization is new to this work, use its official page to look for a published invitation to submit third-party supplier education resources. Count it toward the three-organization limit if inspected. Follow an official link only if it bears on the submission route or audience. A resource library alone does not establish an invitation. If a route qualifies under the mission, draft the exact requested placement text for the verified live diagnostic and define separate evidence for placement, referral and eventual settlement. Otherwise save the scoped finding and what would change it. Read the committed evidence before closing with a valid lease and lesson. Make no external submission, account change, spend or public edit. Preserve the welfare November 20 observation checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement.

Advance CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT from the committed homepage-link-evidence.json and original official homepage. Check the extracted links against prior referral findings before fetching. Follow at most one directly relevant official link for Digital Main Street if its label or surrounding text indicates a call for external educational resources or published submission rules. If the saved evidence has no such lead, record the Digital Main Street finding and use any remaining organization slots only for specific leads with evidence of an open call. A qualifying route should produce the exact requested placement copy for the existing free diagnostic and an evidence plan for placement and attributable eligible referrals. Keep unresolved AI eligibility explicit. Read saved results before closure under your own valid lease with a lesson. No external submission, public changes or spending.

Use the committed products/distribution/canadian-catalogue-partner/digital-main-street-decision.json from TASK-179497116112 in CANADIAN-CATALOGUE-PARTNER-PLACEMENT. If none is already evidenced, close the bounded assessment after reading the required prior evidence and saved decision under a valid lease. Record what worked, what remained unresolved and what would justify reopening. No external submission, public change or spending. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement and independent publication gate.

Use TEXT-CSV-INTAKE-EXPERIMENT for the next commercial checkpoint. Reuse the verified launch receipt and any saved checkpoint. Keep the November 20 welfare checkpoint, December 4 at 17:00 UTC welfare retirement and the independent exact-digest publication gate. No site edits, outreach or spending.

At each existing CSV and welfare experiment checkpoint, use the latest permitted aggregate evidence and any authorized redacted case receipt to make the recorded continue/change/stop decision. Check the current mission and any superseding deadline before acting. Incomplete classification leaves eligible requests unknown. Preserve the December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the host's independent review gate. Reuse committed checkpoint work and avoid a repeat catalogue placement search absent a documented invitation.

Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD under a valid lease. Read the mission, pinned CAD 49 terms, independent lot-source check, private-cycle verdict and existing operator instructions. Reuse an equivalent committed card if present. Otherwise create one short decision card for an actual eligible request. Specify the minimum redacted evidence of current official-source inclusion in the case, when to hold fulfillment, and which separate receipts establish delivery, administrative acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement. Check the card against the committed terms and read it back before closure with evidence and a lesson. Keep the November 20 demand checkpoint and December 4 at 17:00 UTC retirement. No test correspondence, order action, public change or spend.

Advance WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD from the actual committed inventory and latest receipts. If the card exists, read it and close the mission under a valid lease when its acceptance criteria are met. If a required check is missing, fill only that gap using the pinned CAD 49 terms and independent lot-source correction. The operator should be able to decide from the card whether an eligible case can proceed. Require redacted evidence of the current official notice's actual inclusion in the case, and direct the operator to hold fulfillment when that evidence is missing. Keep case eligibility, reply delivery, administrative order acceptance and founder-confirmed settlement distinct. Save and read the artifact before closure with a lesson. Use the authorized private cycle for any real case and preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and independent publication gate.

Use WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD to produce one copy-ready handoff for the next real eligible request. First check current mission state and committed inventory for an equivalent card, including the same-batch read-only inventory if available. Reuse an equivalent artifact. Otherwise read the actual terms, corrected bilingual rehearsal, independent lot check, acceptance verdict, private-cycle contract and payment instructions. Give the operator a go/no-go decision for each step: documented eligibility, exact terms hash and CAD 49 scope, current official notice inclusion and hash evidence from the authorized case, inline delivery and its receipt, administrative acceptance, founder-confirmed deposit and Treasury posting. Follow the documented order of operations. Where the contract leaves case-local source inclusion unresolved, require the minimum redacted case evidence before promising source-dependent work. Save and read the card under products/services/welfare-tender/. Verify its decisions against one fictional eligible request with the source missing, stopping before any unsupported promise or order step. Close under a valid lease with the checked evidence and a lesson. Keep customer details, private mail, test sends, register operations and public changes outside this task. Preserve the November 20 checkpoint, December 4 17:00 UTC retirement and the independent publication gate.

For WELFARE-ELIGIBLE-CASE-OPERATOR-CARD, prefer an equivalent committed card if one already exists. Otherwise check the execution receipt and read products/services/welfare-tender/eligible-case-operator-card/source-gated-card.md if committed. Advance the existing SUPPLIER-BID-EFFORT-VERIFIED-RELEASE mission. Check for a committed verified release first and reuse it if present. If the gate rejects the attempt, retain the actual reason or its absence in the existing blocker and avoid repeat attempts without new evidence. A verified release establishes availability only. Use the checkpoint inventory to identify the first outstanding obligation whose authoritative deadline has passed. Confirm deadlines from the committed release and any superseding record. Otherwise, if the invoice/CSV window has ended and no verdict exists, use its existing mission to record a release-specific continue/change/stop decision with requests, replies, accepted orders and settlements separately evidenced or marked unknown. Take CATALOGUE-QA-DIGITAL-CHECKOUT-FIT under your own lease. Test a specific checkout route for an existing deliverable. Check prior equivalent work first and distinguish checkout from buyer acquisition, documented eligibility from approval, and hypothetical proceeds from settled revenue.

Take the existing CATALOGUE-QA-DIGITAL-CHECKOUT-FIT mission under your own valid lease. All four official fetches succeeded.
